$comment: Draft configuration contract for rig-hooks-session-graph. Runtime loading and invocation are not implemented by adding these files. Defaults are annotations; the runtime must apply them explicitly.
title: Zbot external hooks configuration v1

$schema.description: Optional editor schema reference; never used to fetch or execute runtime code.

id.description: Unique hook ID within this file. Duplicate IDs must be rejected by the loader.

command.description: Executable followed by literal arguments, without shell/tilde/variable/template expansion. Bare programs use permitted PATH; canonical program/script files must be operator-managed and outside ward/project roots. Relative programs/scripts resolve from the vault, never an active ward. See external-hooks spec for trust checks.

cwd.description: v1 cwd is the configured vault root. Ward/project-relative hook execution requires a separate trust contract and is not supported.

on_failure.description: continue records failure and continues. block prevents the pending operation at a supported pre-action boundary; it never rolls back a completed action.
